💲 Product Prices
Set the base price for every product — Retail, Wholesale and Custom. All prices are entered BEFORE GST; the customer pays the price plus the product's GST.
🏷️ New here? Read this first (click to hide / show)
Each product can have three prices. While billing, the cashier picks a mode and that price is charged automatically.
RetailThe normal walk-in base price. You type the price before GST.
WholesaleA lower base price for bulk / shop buyers. You type the exact price (before GST) — there is no automatic discount.
CustomA custom base price. Same idea — type the exact price (before GST) you want to charge in Custom mode.
🧾 All prices here are GST-exclusive (before tax). GST is added on top at billing — the GST column shows each product's rate, and the grey ≈ ₹… incl. line under each box previews what the customer actually pays. Example: a Mug priced ₹100 with 18% GST → the customer pays ₹118.
⚠️ Leave Wholesale or Custom blank to block it. A product with no Wholesale price simply can't be sold in Wholesale mode until you set one. Retail always works.
📈 Auto-WS at qty — type a quantity (e.g. 10) to make a normal Retail line switch itself to the Wholesale price automatically once the cashier rings that many of the item. Below the quantity it stays Retail. Needs a Wholesale price set. Leave blank to turn it off.
How to set a price
1  Find the product with the search box below  →  2  Type the before-GST price into the Retail, Wholesale or Custom box  →  3  Click that row's green Save.
Example: a Coffee Mug at 18% GST → you type Retail ₹100, Wholesale ₹80, Custom ₹70. Walk-in customers pay ₹100 + 18% = ₹118.
